Name: Google Cloud Platform BigQuery
Author: Microsoft - support@microsoft.com
Description:
The [Google Cloud Platform BigQuery](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests BigQuery rows exported to Pub/Sub by continuous queries using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). Existing playbooks enrich incidents, create watchlists, and retrieve query results.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution depends on the following technologies, which might incur additional ingestion or operational costs or be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/):

- [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)
- [Azure Monitor Logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/data-platform-logs)
- [Azure Logic Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/logic-apps/logic-apps-overview)
